name: sage-variants
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent production sprite atlas EXACTLY 2 columns and 2 rows of four distinct fully isolated chibi philosopher characters, each centered inside its equal square cell with clear transparent gutters and full body visible. Top left: DELPHI SOCRATES, friendly bald round head, fluffy short white beard, ivory toga with dusty lavender sash and tiny olive laurel, one hand raised asking a question, other holding small rolled parchment, barefoot, mischievous curious face. Top right: MASTER CONFUCIUS, black traditional tall scholar cap, black eyebrows and long dark beard, celadon-green ancient Chinese scholar robe with cream trim, holds bamboo manuscript and a simple wooden pointer, kind serious teacher expression. Bottom left: ELDER CONFUCIUS same identity as top right, now white beard, pale jade robe and muted antique gold edging, holds open bamboo manuscript with both hands, wise dignified cute expression; NO imperial crown or throne. Bottom right: STREET SOCRATES same identity as top left but plain ivory toga, no laurel, simple slate sash, open questioning hand and rolled parchment. All same squat proportions: head half height, tiny body and legs, about 32x40 native pixels enlarged in crisp 16-bit chunky pixel art. Muted pastel cream mint lavender dark plum outline. No backgrounds no text no aura no glow no particles no cell borders. Genuine transparent alpha. CRITICAL STYLE REFERENCE: use the attached existing sprite atlas as reference ONLY for the exact pixel grid, proportions and face simplification. Match its two small vertical dot eyes, no iris highlights, tiny smiling mouth, very large round head, body only one-third total height. Far fewer pixels and details than a drawn cartoon. Every edge must follow a coarse square pixel grid. The four new characters must belong to this exact same game as the reference. Do not copy all 16 sprites; output ONLY the requested 2x2 four variants.
